# Issue 5: Save and reload one room locally

## Summary

Persist a scanned room on device and reload it after relaunch, including safe handling for corrupt data and deletion.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Scan can be saved
- [ ] Saved room appears after relaunch
- [ ] Corrupt or incompatible data is handled
- [ ] Room can be deleted
- [ ] All related local data is removed

## Notes

Local-only storage is required. No account or cloud sync in the MVP.
